rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for information or a communication that someone conveys.

example.jyutping: ngo5 sau1 dou2 nei5 ge3 seon3 sik1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the meaning or point that someone understands from a book, film, or speech in everyday conversation.

example.english: The message of this film is quite profound.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 ji3 si1 gei2 sam1

rows.note: Use this for the central message or main point of a text, especially in formal discussion or writing.

example.english: The main message of this article is to remind everyone to cherish time.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章嘅主旨係提醒大家珍惜時間。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 ge3 zyu2 zi2 hai6 tai4 sing2 daai6 gaa1 zan1 sik1 si4 gaan3
